Override.//EntityFrameworkCore: EF logs every executed statement at Information under Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command. At production traffic that is several log lines per request, which buries the lines an operator is actually looking for and costs real money in log storage. Warning still surfaces what matters — connection failures, retries, concurrency violations. Development turns it back up.
Override.//Npgsql: Same reasoning one layer down: the ADO provider narrates connection open/close per command.

Otlp.//: Set an OTLP collector endpoint (e.g. http://otel-collector:4317) to enable OTLP export. Empty = disabled; the host does not require a collector to run.
